A Reuters/Ipsos poll released Oct. 26 — just days before Election Day — finds Trump's approval rating has ticked up to 32%, a one-percentage-point increase from the previous week's record low of 31%.

When asked which party they would support in congressional elections, 47% chose Democrats, compared with 36% who favored Republicans.

Another 11% said they were undecided.



The findings come as Republicans work to maintain control of both the U.S. House of Representatives and Senate. [...] The NPR/PBS/Marist survey included 1,289 registered voters and had a margin of error of 3.8 percentage points.
